[FILE] work/deploy_github_pages.sh --- #!/usr/bin/env bash set -e # Configuration REPO_NAME="landing-page-demo" ORG="" # leave empty to create under your user account; set to "orgname" to create under an organization # Create temporary working directory WORKDIR=$(mktemp -d) cd "$WORKDIR" # Create repository files cat > index.html <<'EOF' Landing Page

Welcome to our Landing Page

This is a simple index.html file hosted on GitHub Pages.

EOF cat > pricing.md <<'EOF' # Pricing | Plan | Price | |------|-------| | Free | \$0 | | Pro | \$9.99/month | EOF cat > README.md <<'EOF' # Landing Page Demo This repository contains a simple landing page that is hosted on GitHub Pages. EOF # Initialize git repository git init git add . git commit -m "Initial commit" # Create GitHub repository using gh CLI if [ -z "$ORG" ]; then gh repo create "$REPO_NAME" --public --source=. --remote=origin --push --confirm else gh repo create "$ORG/$REPO_NAME" --public --source=. --remote=origin --push --confirm fi # Enable GitHub Pages gh pages set --branch main --path . --confirm echo "Repository $REPO_NAME has been created and GitHub Pages enabled." [RUN] bash work/deploy_github_pages.sh [RESULT_CHECK] 命令输出包含 "Repository landing-page-demo has been created and GitHub Pages enabled."
